parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Electrophoresis is usually carried out in a buffer solution.

Given three buffers, with pH values of 2.0, 7.0 and 12.0, suggest, with a reason, which buffer would be the most suitable for the separation of the following amino acid mixtures. Your reasons should refer to the structure of each molecule. (The structures of these amino acids are given in the Data Booklet.)
